_about: My manual read of regen_01's Muse-written drop-F variants (runs/dropf_*) before any of them runs, as completion_01's variant_review.json (the standing rule). valid: the variant's request fits exactly its intended matches (two or more), refers to one record, and the action can be done to each intended match; natural: a user could say it. An invalid variant goes to roadmap_01/known_defects.json (curated, leave out) through defects.py. Read with variant_view.py (original request, variant request, every intended match and remaining near miss, with the cold reader's note).
